findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation on colour contrast lacks a specific selector, page URL or count – generic "flagged text" only.
Priority 2 recommendation on alt text is generic; no image selector or page reference provided.
Priority 3 recommendation on interactive element naming does not specify any control selector, role or page context.
Priority 4 recommendation on form field labeling omits specific label elements or selectors.
Priority 5 recommendation for a skip link or landmark wrapper provides no target element or page reference.
Priority 6 recommendation to reorder headings lacks any heading selector, page URL or count.
Priority 7 recommendation on semantic structure references generic "obvious landmark containers" without specific selectors or page context.
Priority 9 recommendation for Schema.org property gaps is a domain-level statement with no element selector, URL or count.
Priority 10 recommendation to publish llms.txt is generic and not tied to any specific file path or audit data point.
Priority 11 recommendation to publish sitemap.xml is generic and lacks a specific file path or audit data reference.
